sources.citation: DiCanio, Christian T. 2017. Oto-Manguean stress systems / Oto-Manguean tonal systems (Google My Maps database behind 'Otomanguean Prosody', 94 languages, fields Stress/Source/Confidence)

sources.note: Secondary database of 'all phonological descriptions/research on Oto-Manguean languages': no Tacahua or Yolotepec entry at all. Nearest Western Alta entries: Chalcatongo 'Stress: NA' (Macaulay 1996), Atatlahuca 'Stress: NA' (Alexander 1980), Molinos 'Stress: variable' (Hunter & Pike 1969).

sources.citation: Auderset, Sandra, Simon J. Greenhill, Christian T. DiCanio & Eric W. Campbell. 2023. Subgrouping in a 'dialect continuum': A Bayesian phylogenetic analysis of the Mixtecan language family. Journal of Language Evolution 8(1): 33-63. doi:10.1093/jole/lzad004

sources.note: Only source Glottolog names for the variety (rated a wordlist or less). Contains the Santa Maria Yolotepec wordlist and 'miscellaneous features'; Yolotepec is not among the 16 phonological systems it analyses, so at best a family-level remark on Mixtec couplet stress, not a description of this variety. Checking it would close the question.
